help.en: A part of the programme with its own lead and status. Place its tasks, deliverables and milestones inside it.
The effort of the tasks inside it, in hours.
The share of the effort of its tasks that is done, in percent.
The name and the progress, shown as the title.
A piece of work for one owner, with an effort and a due date.
The effort when the task is done, otherwise 0. Workstreams add it up for their progress.
Yes when it is not done and its date has passed.
Something a project hands over, with a due date and how it will be accepted.
Yes when it is not done and its date has passed.

constraints.message: = 'Deliverable "' + Name + '" belongs to no workstream: place it in one, or connect a workstream or task to it with "Delivers".'

help.en: A point in time that marks progress, such as the end of a phase.

attributes.formula: Reached ? 'Reached' : Date == null ? null : Date < today() ? 'Overdue' : daysBetween(today(), Date) <= 14 ? 'Due soon' : 'Planned'

help.en: Reached, Overdue (its date has passed and it is not reached), Due soon (within 14 days) or Planned. It colours the shape.

attributes.formula: Reached || Date == null ? null : daysBetween(today(), Date)

help.en: Days from today to its date; below 0 when it is overdue.
Something that may go wrong. Score is likelihood times impact; Rating turns it into Low, Medium or High and colours the shape.

attributes.formula: Likelihood == null || Impact == null ? null : Likelihood * Impact

help.en: Likelihood times impact, from 1 to 25.
High from 15, Medium from 8, otherwise Low.
What you do about it: avoid it, reduce it, pass it on, or accept it.
What is done to make it less likely or less harmful.

constraints.message: = 'High risk "' + Name + '" has ' + (isEmpty(Owner) ? 'no owner' : 'no mitigation') + ': ' + (isEmpty(Owner) ? 'give it an owner.' : 'describe the mitigation, or connect a task or decision to it with "Addresses".')

help.en: Something taken as true for planning that still needs to be checked.
A problem that is happening now and needs an owner to resolve it.

constraints.message: = 'Issue "' + Name + '" is open and has no owner to resolve it.'

help.en: Something the work needs from elsewhere, and by when it is needed.
Who must deliver it.
Yes when it is not done and its date has passed.
A choice that was made or must be made, with the reason for it.

constraints.message: = 'Decision "' + Name + '" is agreed but has no rationale: write down why it was made.'

help.en: A project or programme. Place its workstreams, and milestones that belong to the whole programme, inside it.
The average progress of its workstreams, in percent.
The name, the status and the progress, shown as the title.

constraints.formula: Start == null || End == null || Start <= End

help.en: One thing needs another to work or to be done first.
A workstream or initiative produces a deliverable.
The milestone is reached only once this task or deliverable is done.
The risk, assumption, issue or dependency affects this part of the plan.
The task mitigates the risk or resolves the issue, or the decision settles it.
The risk happened and is now an issue.
The effort of all tasks, in hours.
The share of the effort of all tasks that is done, in percent.
How many risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies the log holds.
A programme with workstreams, tasks, deliverables and milestones, and its RAID log: risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and decisions.

parts.fill: = Status == 'Not started' ? '#f8f9fa' : Status == 'In progress' ? '#ffe8cc' : Status == 'Done' ? '#d3f9d8' : Status == 'Blocked' ? '#ffc9c9' : '#f8f9fa'
= Status == 'Not started' ? '#f8f9fa' : Status == 'In progress' ? '#ffe8cc' : Status == 'Done' ? '#d3f9d8' : Status == 'Blocked' ? '#ffc9c9' : '#f8f9fa'
